{{Quote|Please. Look, I'm an inventor, right? A damn good inventor. You let me live, I'll invent you something. Whatever you want.|Dorotsech, mentioning his qualities while begging for his life|<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" />}}
'''Dorotsech''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] around [[3643 BBY]]. He developed a weapon called the [[cyber neutralizer]] that could [[Death/Legends|kill]] or weaken [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] whose bodies were composed of at least fifty percent [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. Dorotsech was held captive by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]] in the [[Lord Grathan's estate|latter's estate]] until [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] came to steal the scientist's creation. However, that was all for which the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] came, and Dorotsech was [[Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|slain]] to eliminate any witnesses.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No, please! Zash said she'd free me. I have a wife and children and an astromech droid&hellip; I have to live.|Dorotsech pleads with Zash's apprentice|<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" />}}
Dorotsech was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] working as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which was fought between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he had a [[Dorotsech's wife|wife]] and children, and owned an [[Dorotsech's astromech droid|astromech droid]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Dorotsech was taken captive by a rogue Sith named [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]] and held in his [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]]. There, Dorotsech was commissioned by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]] to develop a weapon called the [[cyber neutralizer]] that could [[Death/Legends|kill]] or weaken [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] whose bodies were composed of at least fifty percent [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], though Dorotsech preferred to remain ignorant of the reasons behind the creation of such a weapon. Zash intended to use the weapon to help defeat her rival, [[Darth Skotia]], so she sent her [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] to [[Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|retrieve]] it and erase any traces that connected the theft of the weapon to them.<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Dorotsech was eventually found by Zash's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] during the latter's infiltration of Grathan's estate, searching for Dorotsech's creation. The scientist revealed the weapon's location and in turn was killed, instead of being set free with the condition of remaining silent about who had stolen the weapon.<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A Human male with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a mustache, Dorotsech was partially bald with brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] on the sides and fair skin. He was a brilliant scientist who was capable of developing a highly effective weapon against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] all by himself. Although a skilled scientist, Dorotsech was not very brave, as he demonstrated to Lord Zash's apprentice during their encounter in which he continuously begged for his life. However, his pleading was ineffective in saving him from the apprentice's lack of compassion, and the scientist was killed right where he stood.<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorotsech appears in the "Dismantling the Machine" mission for the [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The player can also choose to warn the scientist to remain silent and let him live, thereby receiving [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points.<ref name="Dismantling the Machine" /> If spared he will later send a message to the player about Skotia's death, and will also send credits with the message.
